title: Cbox CMS blueprint, version 1
description: One schema file under schema/**/*.yaml: a type, or an extension of another owner's type (PRD 11.12, 13.1). Version 1 grows only by additions: a file that is valid stays valid and keeps its meaning. The reference page is docs/addons/blueprint-v1.md in the Cbox CMS repository.

blueprint.description: The format marker. A reader refuses any other version.

handle.description: Lowercase snake_case of at most 63 bytes, without a double underscore. `ext` and the prefix `cms_` are reserved (PRD 11.12).

locale.description: A locale as a key of a text map: a language of two or three letters, with an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or zh-Hant-TW.

label.description: A label: one text of 1 to 100 characters, or a map of locale to such a text, whose first entry is the text used where one text is needed (gap G2).

description.description: A description: one text of 1 to 1,000 characters, or a map of locale to such a text, whose first entry is the text used where one text is needed (gap G2).

classification.description: The data classification of the field (PRD 12.2). Fields inside a group inherit it. This edition has no `personal` or `sensitive`: such a field must declare its purpose, legal basis, retention, recipients and subject (PRD 12.4, 12.14), which this edition cannot express, so it is refused until an addition to version 1 brings them with those keys.

version.description: The owner's version of the definition, which upcasters are keyed on (PRD 11.4, 11.12).

type_id.description: The stable id of the type, unchanged when the type is renamed (PRD 11.2).

layout.description: The layout of the type's form: tabs and a sidebar that place every top-level field of the file exactly once (gap G2). Without it the fields land in one tab of one section in file order.

localization.description: How the type is localized (PRD 10.1): `none`, one shared variant with every field, or `variants`, a variant per language that holds the fields declared `translatable` and the shared variant that holds the others.

extends.description: The type_id of the type that the fields are added to, in the extender's namespace (PRD 11.12).

layout.description: A layout fragment that places the file's fields in the type's form (gap G2): a tab or a section whose handle the type's layout has joins it, the rest are appended. Without it the fields land in the tab `extensions`.

The tabs of a form and its sidebar (gap G2). Every top-level field of the file is placed exactly once, in a tab or in the sidebar; the fields inside a group are never placed, because the group's input holds them. The handles of the tabs, and of the sections within a tab and within the sidebar, are unique.

sidebar.description: The sections shown beside the tabs.

layoutTab.description: A tab: a labelled page of sections.

layoutSection.description: A section: a run of fields, with an optional label and instructions, which the form lets the editor collapse when it is collapsible.

layoutField.description: The place of one top-level field of the file: its handle and the width it takes in the section's row.

width.description: A width preset: full (the default), half, third or two_thirds. cms:generate refuses any other word with generate_layout_width_unknown.

ui.description: The hints a form takes for a field's input (gap G2). They are presentation only: a read-only or hidden field is still written by the commands and validated as its rules say.

input_hint.description: A hint shown in the empty input.

read_only.description: Whether the form shows the value without an input to change it.

hidden.description: Whether the form hides the input.

display.description: How a select shows its choices. Only a select field may have it.

summary.description: The summary template of a repeated group, which names the group's nested fields in braces, such as `{title} ({year})`, so a collapsed item shows its values. Only a group with repeat may have it, and cms:generate refuses a handle the group does not have with generate_summary_field_unknown.

condition.description: A condition of the typed grammar (gap G3), with no expressions: a field compared with eq, neq or in, asked for a value with null or not_null, or all or any of other conditions. In YAML, quote the key null, as "null": true, because a bare null is no key.

conditionField.description: The field a condition reads: a handle of a sibling, ../ once per group up before a handle of a sibling of a group the field is in, or ext.<namespace>.<handle> for a top-level field of the extender's own namespace.

conditionValue.description: A value a field is compared with: a string for a text, long text or select field, a whole number for an integer, true or false for a boolean.

conditionCompare.description: The field's value is (eq) or is not (neq) the value.

conditionIn.description: The field's value is one of the values.

conditionPresence.description: The field has no value (null) or has one (not_null).

conditionCombined.description: Every condition holds (all), or at least one does (any).

topLevelAgents.description: Whether MCP tools and agents see a top-level field (PRD 12.2, 14.5): as its `agents` says, or else when it is public or internal. A confidential field is seen only with `agents: true`. This edition has no `personal` or `sensitive`, which agents never see (PRD 2.31, 12.2).

seenByAgents.description: A field that agents see needs a description (PRD 14.5). The fields of a group that agents see are seen unless they say `agents: false`.

hiddenFromAgents.description: The fields of a group that agents do not see are hidden unless they say `agents: true`.

description.description: What the field holds. Required for a field that agents see (PRD 12.2, 14.5); it is also the help text in the panel.

type.description: A core field type, or `<namespace>:<handle>` for a field type an addon contributes (PRD 13.1). `app` and `ext` are reserved and never an addon's namespace (PRD 11.12).

translatable.description: Which variant of an entry holds the field in a type with `localization: variants` (PRD 10.1): a language's variant when true, the shared variant when false. Only a type with `localization: variants` may have it; a field inside a group has its group's.

fallback.description: How a translatable field falls back when the reader's language has no value for it (PRD 10.3): `variant`, the default, along the site's chain with its whole variant, so a page never mixes languages; or `field`, on its own. Only a translatable field may have it.

agents.description: Whether MCP tools and agents see the field (PRD 12.2, 14.5). Without it, a top-level field is seen when it is public or internal, and a field inside a group as the group is. A field agents see needs a description.

ui.description: The hints a form takes for the input, see the ui definition.

when.description: The condition the field is shown on (gap G3): while it does not hold, the field is hidden, never required, and holds no value with when_hidden: clear. It reads siblings of the field, or with ../ siblings of a group the field is in, within the same set of fields: the owner's, or the fields one extender adds, whose top-level fields may also be named ext.<namespace>.<handle> of its own namespace. cms:generate refuses a cycle, another owner's namespace, a field above the field's classification and a field it cannot reach, each with its own generate_when_* code.

when_hidden.description: What happens to the value of the conditional field while it is hidden (gap G3): clear, it holds none and a form clears it, or keep, it keeps the value it has. Every field with when declares it, and only such a field.

default.description: The value the form starts the input with (gap G2), form only and never filled in by a command: a string for text and long_text, an integer for integer, a decimal as a quoted string for decimal, a boolean for boolean, a quoted date or the token today for date, a quoted time with its offset or the token now for datetime, an option's value for select, or a list of them with multiple: true. A group, rich text and a relation take none. cms:generate refuses another kind with generate_default_wrong_kind.

min.description: A decimal number as a string, so that it is read without rounding.

max.description: A decimal number as a string, so that it is read without rounding.

min.description: A date as a quoted string. A YAML parser reads an unquoted date as a number.

max.description: A date as a quoted string. A YAML parser reads an unquoted date as a number.

min.description: A time in RFC 3339 with its offset, Z or +hh:mm, as a quoted string. A YAML parser reads an unquoted time as a number.

max.description: A time in RFC 3339 with its offset, Z or +hh:mm, as a quoted string. A YAML parser reads an unquoted time as a number.

relationOptions.description: A reference to other entries (PRD 5.11, 11.6): one entry, a uuid column with a foreign key to entries, or with multiple: true a list of at most max_items entries, each once, kept in a jsonb column. The kernel refuses a target that does not exist or whose type is not one of types. A relation is public or internal, because a foreign key cannot hold ciphertext (PRD 12.2), and it is neither filterable nor sortable.

types.description: The types a target may have, each `<owner>:<handle>` of a type a blueprint file defines, such as `app:article`. cms:generate refuses a name no blueprint defines with generate_unknown_relation_type.

addonOptions.description: The choices of an addon's field type sit under `options`, so they never collide with a choice that version 1 adds to every field. The reader checks them against the JSON Schema that the addon contributes.
